About.title: Celebrating 60 Years of Can Tho University (1966-2026)
About.content:
---
## 1. Our Inspiration
This application is part of the celebration for the **60th anniversary of Can Tho University**. For six decades, CTU has been a center of knowledge and growth. In that same spirit, we built this application to allow the community to learn about the university's memorable historical milestones, while also providing an exciting tool for generating images and videos.

## 2. Powered by Open Source
We believe that technology should be transparent and shared, much like the education provided at our university. To build this app, we used **"Open-Source"** models. This means that the "blueprints" of these models and tools have been shared for free by researchers around the world.

Our system is powered by the following open-source technologies:
* **GPT-OSS 20B** (Apache 2.0 License)
* **DeepSeek R1 8B** (MIT License)
* **Qwen Image Edit** (Apache 2.0 License)
* **Wan 2.2** (Apache 2.0 License)
* *Supported by various open-source libraries.*
